query:
UPDATE fuel_measurements f
SET
    fuel_liter = $1,
    barentswatch_user_id = $2,
    timestamp = $3
FROM
    active_vessels w
WHERE
    f.fuel_measurement_id = $4
    AND w.call_sign = $5
    AND w.fiskeridir_vessel_id = f.fiskeridir_vessel_id
RETURNING
    f.fiskeridir_vessel_id AS "fiskeridir_vessel_id: FiskeridirVesselId",
    f.timestamp,
    f.fuel_liter
